name: Cinnabar Island & Pokémon Lab
summary: Arrive at the volcanic sanctuary of Cinnabar Island. Obtain the Super Rod from the offshore fisherman, revive pre-historic fossils in the Pokémon Lab, complete high-value in-game NPC trades, and defeat the laboratory's security robots to claim Infinite Splicers and Infinite Reversers.

items.name: Super Rod
items.method: Gift from the Fishing Guru in the moored fishing vessel off the southeast coast

items.name: Infinite Splicers
items.method: Reward in the laboratory testing room after defeating security robot R.E.D.

items.name: Infinite Reversers
items.method: Reward in the laboratory testing room after defeating all defense robots

items.name: Metal Coat
items.method: Trade Metal Powder and 5,000 PokeDollars in the house west of the Poke Mart
